title: Missed call and job intake system
overview: Coastline misses after hours calls and re-types every job into Jobber by hand. We will install an AI receptionist that answers those calls, books suitable jobs and creates them in Jobber, with a short summary for you each morning.

problems.unit: new customer calls missed a month
problems.text: Calls after 5pm go to voicemail. Most of those customers ring the next plumber.
Every enquiry is copied into Jobber by hand, so quotes go out a day late.

calc: 28 calls x 20% that become jobs x $1,400 average job = about $94,000 a year in potential work. Office time: 12 hours x $32 an hour = about $20,000 a year, time freed up rather than cash saved. Figures from our call on 6 November.

build.name: After hours receptionist
build.text: Answers missed and after hours calls on your number, takes the details and books suitable jobs.

build.name: Job intake
build.text: Every booking becomes a Jobber job with the caller's details, so nobody re-types notes.

build.name: Morning summary
build.text: One message at 7am with new jobs, urgent calls and anything that needs a person.

connects: your phone line, Google Calendar and Jobber

timeline.name: Agree and connect
timeline.text: Call script, booking rules and access.

timeline.name: Build and test
timeline.text: Tested on sample calls, not live customers.

timeline.name: Train and go live
timeline.text: Your team tries it, then we switch it on.

needs: phone forwarding access, a Jobber login and 10 example calls.
next_step: sign the one page agreement, pay the $3,750 deposit and we book the kickoff call for next week.
